title: COMPONENTS FOR DISASSEMBLY AND ASSEMBLY
ocr_text:
EG–268
ENGINE – SFI SYSTEM (2JZ–GTE)

• Keep the fuel pump as far away from the battery as possible.
• Always connect or disconnect at the battery.
If operation is not as specified, replace the fuel pump, lead wire or fuel pump bracket.

COMPONENTS FOR DISASSEMBLY AND ASSEMBLY

Lead Wire
for Fuel Pump
Fuel Hose
Fuel Pump
Fuel Pump Filter
◆ Clip
Rubber Cushion
◆ Non-reusable part

Fuel Sender Gauge
Fuel Pump Bracket

P18050

FUEL PUMP DISASSEMBLY
Assembly is in the reverse order of disassembly.
1. REMOVE FUEL SENDER GAUGE FROM FUEL PUMP BRACKET
(a) Disconnect the connector from the fuel pump bracket.
(b) Remove the 2 screws and sender gauge.
